set.body: Scope: PRD Phases 3-5. Implement one typed applicative DecodePlan[ResponseBlock] with logical value slots and a representation-specific DecodeConsistency separate from ReconstructionContract; bind it to LNA with raw-bit persistence evidence and interrupted-publication tests; add namespaced representation keys, narrow envelopes, an immutable registry, a named legacy family, and ScalafimRuntime.openResponse. Close only when the unchanged decoder agrees across memory and LNA under DecodeConsistency, the frozen numerical corpus remains green, logical payload bits survive persistence unless an admitted profile declares normalization, partial writes never appear published, files can select only installed code, and runtime resources close on success, failure, and cancellation.
